title: The Crossover Ashoka®
subtitle: Two rows crossing at the center — drawn as one ring, never two.

stone.origin: Natural. Upper row set east-west, lower row north-south on a waved band. [NOTE: exact carat weights not available — confirm before going live.]

description: A two-row ring designed as a single piece rather than two bands stacked together. The upper row of elongated Ashoka-style step cuts runs east-west across the finger; the lower row runs north-south on a gently waved shank, so the two lines meet and hold at the centre in a true crossover. The effect depends on that intersection being drawn as one gesture — the rows belong to each other, not merely beside each other. Made in eighteen-karat yellow or white gold.
